subject: Developer docs lead: tech demo & timezone coordination
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@fluxdev.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interested in a technical demo — developer quickstart

Hi Soojin,

We just finished the docs quickstart and I wanted to follow up to request a technical demo focused on inference deployment and cost controls. I'm a dev on the infra team at FluxDev — Priya (copied) will join. We're most interested in: runtime performance tuning, private deployment options, and batching/kv cache behavior for low-latency services.

Our timezone is Pacific (PST). Best windows for us next week are mornings between 9–11am PST. Can your team do a 30–45 minute walk-through and Q&A?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior Platform Engineer
FluxDev

Attachment: FluxDev-SSOT-deck.pdf (one-pager: topology + goals)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@fluxdev.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interested in a technical demo — developer quickstart

Alex — great to meet you and thanks for running the quickstart. Happy to get Marcus (SE) on the call for a focused technical deep-dive.

A few quick options (all 30 minutes):
- Tue 11/23 — 10:00am PST (1:00pm EST)
- Tue 11/23 — 11:00am PST (2:00pm EST)
- Wed 11/24 — 11:00am PST (2:00pm EST)

If none of those work you can also pick a slot on Marcus's calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/marcus-30m (feel free to propose other times).

To make the session most useful: could you confirm which of the three topics below you want prioritized?
1) Serving/runtime internals (kernels, kv cache, batching)
2) Deployment patterns (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
3) Cost/perf levers and observability (batching, quantization, tracing)

We'll include a short agenda and a link to a sandbox so you can see an example tail latency profile if helpful.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
SDR — Developer GTM
Redwood Inference
